## 5. Subscription & Pricing

### 5.1 Subscription Plans

The Service offers the following subscription plans:

- **Free Plan**: 3 meal suggestions per week, basic features
- **Starter Plan**: CAD $9.99/month — Unlimited meal suggestions, grocery integration
- **Pro Plan**: CAD $19.99/month — Family planning, nutritional analysis, meal prep

**All prices include GST/HST (13% Ontario).**

### 5.2 Billing

- **Payment Method**: Credit card, debit card (via Stripe)
- **Billing Cycle**: Monthly or annual (as selected)
- **Auto-Renewal**: Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled
- **Cancellation**: You can cancel at any time (see Section 5.3)

### 5.3 Cancellation & Refunds

- **Cancellation**: You can cancel your subscription at any time in-app or by emailing support@whats-for-dinner.ca
- **Refunds**: 30-day money-back guarantee (full refund within 30 days of purchase)
- **Effect of Cancellation**: Access continues until the end of the billing period

### 5.4 Price Changes

We reserve the right to change subscription prices. We will notify you at least 30 days in advance of any price changes.
